investigation_notes.Scriptblock Summary: PowerShell enumerates Active Directory objects and group policy links using Get-ADOrganizationalUnit, Get-ADComputer, Get-ADUser and Get-GPInheritance, converts results to JSON, and attempts to write output to a local agent directory. The script is readable and shows no obvious encoding or obfuscation.
investigation_notes.Description: A readable PowerShell script executed as SYSTEM on HOST-01 that enumerates Active Directory OUs, computers, users, and GPO inheritance, then writes the JSON output to local agent-related directories. The script uses standard AD cmdlets and references local agent file paths with no obfuscation, external IPs, or suspicious encodings observed. Based on the legitimate AD discovery behavior, benign file paths, and absence of external indicators or known malicious hashes, this activity is assessed as Low Priority and appears consistent with an inventory/agent operation.
